summary: One-click rig setup, offered instead of shipping a prefab.
overview: Wires the rig onto objects in YOUR scene, which is the one thing a prefab cannot do. A prefab would bake a camera and its settings into a binary asset that cannot be diffed or hand-edited, and it still would not know which object is your player.
whereToFind: Toolkit ▸ Camera ▸ Set Up Third Person Camera On Selection (and the first-person variant)
useCases: Setting up a player camera in a new scene without hand-assigning fields.
Getting a working third-person camera in one step while prototyping.

gotchas.title: It acts on the current selection
gotchas.body: The menu item is disabled with nothing selected. Select the player first, not the camera.
